title: This Portfolio Website
description: A static, single page portfolio showcasing my education, experience, skills, and coursework, with light and dark themes and a responsive layout. Features an animated particle background, a filterable class list, and a project carousel generated from JSON data. Built with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and React using Vite, with deployment TBD.

title: Castle Defense
description: A 2D tower defense game where players strategically place defensive blocks to protect a portal from incoming enemies. Features physics-based movement, sound effects, and collision detection. Built with TypeScript using Node.js and npm for development, with deployment to GitHub Pages through GitHub Actions.

title: Marble Racing
description: A 3D racing game where players control a marble through obstacle filled tracks while competing against other marbles. Features simulated gravity, friction, collision handling, and camera-relative movement. Built with TypeScript and GopherGfx, using Node.js and npm for development, with deployment to GitHub Pages through GitHub Actions.

title: Earthquake Visualization
description: An interactive visualization of global earthquakes from 1905–2007, featuring smooth transitions between a 2D map and a 3D globe. Animates earthquake activity over time, using marker size and color to represent magnitude. Built with TypeScript and GopherGfx using NASA Earth imagery and USGS earthquake data, and deployed to GitHub Pages through GitHub Actions.

title: So You Think Ants Can Dance
description: An interactive animation project that brings dancing characters to life using Carnegie Mellon motion capture data. Features custom character models, skeletal animation, and smooth transitions between idle poses and user-selected dance moves. Built with TypeScript using hierarchical scene graphs and matrix transformations, and deployed to GitHub Pages through GitHub Actions.

title: Artistic Rendering
description: An interactive 3D model viewer showcasing lighting and shading techniques, including Gouraud, Phong, cartoon shading with silhouette outlines, and normal mapping for detailed surfaces. Built with custom GLSL shaders, TypeScript, and GopherGfx, and deployed to GitHub Pages through GitHub Actions.

title: A World Made Of Drawings
description: An interactive world building program that turns mouse drawings into sky artwork, standing objects, and terrain with hills and valleys. Built with TypeScript using ray casting, intersection testing, and dynamic mesh editing, and deployed to GitHub Pages through GitHub Actions.
